tasks.label: 1A
tasks.title: Untried forensic angles on whether the remaining 6000 volume is permanent
tasks.instructions: 1A is the thinnest label. Brainstorm 5-6 untried, no-login public sources that would show whether the NovaSeq 6000's remaining ~41% of consumables revenue is migrating or staying put. Do NOT propose: Wayback, GTR, SAM.gov, used-equipment dealers/surplus, ENA/SRA/GEO counts, Clarity/software release notes, EDGAR full-text sweeps, job boards, or Taiwan PCC (all done or dry). Ideas to test: Illumina regional (JP/KR/EU) 6000 reagent-kit discontinuation or last-order notices; distributor list-price PDFs in other countries showing 6000 kit price changes; CLIA/state lab-licence instrument amendments outside NY; hospital capital budgets or board minutes approving 6000-to-X replacement; the IVD-assay menu on the 6000Dx vs the X in non-US regulatory databases (e.g. Health Canada MDALL, TGA ARTG). For each source, open at least one page to check access. Return candidates with URLs and the access you verified. Stop after about 12 minutes.
